WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id AS order_id,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)) AS order_total
  FROM order_items AS oi
  WHERE oi.order_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
order_payment_types AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id AS order_id,
    MIN(op.payment_type) AS payment_type
  FROM order_payments AS op
  WHERE op.order_id IS NOT NULL
    AND op.payment_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  opt.payment_type AS payment_type,
  AVG(ot.order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM order_totals AS ot
JOIN order_payment_types AS opt
  ON opt.order_id = ot.order_id
WHERE opt.payment_type IS NOT NULL
  AND ot.order_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY opt.payment_type
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;
